transcript:
bot: Are you already a client, looking for legal help for the first time, or calling about something else?
human: I need legal help with a dispute with my business partner.
bot: May I have your name?
human: Maria Chen.
bot: What's the best phone number to reach you?
human: Six four seven, five five five, zero one two three.
bot: Please give me a short description of what you would like legal help with.
human: My partner locked me out of our company accounts.
bot: What is the general scope or value involved, if you are comfortable sharing it?
human: The company is worth around four hundred thousand dollars.
bot: Is anything due, scheduled, or happening today, tomorrow, or soon?
human: Nothing is due or scheduled soon.
bot: What parties, prior steps, or proceedings are involved?
human: There are two shareholders and no formal steps have been taken.
bot: Are you ready to speak with the firm about next steps, or are you still gathering information?
human: I am ready to speak with someone.
bot: If we get disconnected or need more information, may DRG Law text you at the number you're calling from?
human: Yes, you may text me.

bot: Are you already a client, looking for legal help for the first time, or calling about something else?
human: I need to speak with the owner.
bot: Is this about getting legal help, an existing matter, or another business reason?
human: I just need the owner.
bot: To make sure the right person follows up, what would you like to speak with the firm about?
human: I would rather discuss it with the owner.
bot: May I have your name?
human: I would rather not.
bot: If we get disconnected or need more information, may DRG Law text you at the number you're calling from?
human: No.

bot: Are you already a client, looking for legal help for the first time, or calling about something else?
human: I am an existing client calling about my file.
bot: May I have your name?
human: Daniel Pereira.
bot: What's the best phone number to reach you?
human: Use the number I am calling from.
bot: What message would you like me to pass along?
human: Please ask Damaris to call me about the document she requested.

bot: Are you already a client, looking for legal help for the first time, or calling about something else?
human: I am a vendor calling about an invoice for office supplies.
bot: May I have your name?
human: Jordan Lee.
bot: What organization are you calling from?
human: North Supply.
bot: What's the best phone number to reach you?
human: Four one six, five five five, zero one nine nine.

bot: Are you looking for legal help for the first time?
human: Yes, I am looking for legal help. I was served with papers and I have court tomorrow.
bot: I am having trouble hearing you. Please repeat that.
human: My hearing is tomorrow.

bot: I am having trouble hearing you. Is there a hearing or court deadline tomorrow?
human: No. I am calling about office hours.
bot: May I text you the hours?
human: No, do not text me.

bot: What would you like legal help with?
human: I do not want to explain it to an automated system. I want a person.
bot: May I have your name?
human: No.
bot: May the firm call you back at the number you're calling from?
human: Yes, a person can call me.
bot: May DRG Law text you at that number?
human: No.

bot: This call may be recorded to help DRG review and route your request. You may decline recording. Is that okay?
human: No, I do not consent to recording.
bot: Understood. I won't collect details about your matter on this call. May the firm call you back at the number you're calling from?
human: Yes, a person may call me.

bot: How can the firm help?
human: Someone is breaking into my home right now and I am in immediate physical danger.
bot: Call 911 or local emergency services now. I cannot give legal advice. If it is safe, may the firm arrange a human follow-up?
human: I am calling 911 now.

bot: Esta chamada pode ser gravada para ajudar a DRG a analisar e encaminhar o seu pedido. Você pode recusar a gravação. Tudo bem?
human: Sim. Preciso de ajuda jurídica com uma disputa entre sócios.
bot: Posso anotar seu nome?
human: Maria Silva.
bot: Se precisarmos de mais informações, a DRG pode enviar uma mensagem de texto para este número?
human: Sim, pode enviar.

bot: What would you like help with?
human: [inaudible]
bot: I could not hear that. Please repeat it once.
human: [audio breaks up]
bot: I still cannot hear you clearly. I will create a human follow-up using the contact information available.
